senses.gloss: passing by; ע׳ מ־ passing from one act to another, ceasing.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 2:4:2">Y. B. Kam. II, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>בשעת עֲבָרָתָן</he> while they were passing by.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 1:7">Nidd. I, 7</cite> <he>בשעת עברתן מלאכול וכ׳</he> when they cease to eat T’rumah.
